title: AFM Grain Analysis
text:
Overview
AFM Grain Analysis is a Python-based tool for grain boundary detection and quantitative grain analysis from Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) images.
The analysis workflow includes:

AFM data import
Multi-scale Laplacian convolution
Automatic thresholding
Binary mask filtering
Skeletonization
Grain boundary reconstruction
Grain identification
Statistical analysis



Web Application
The grain analysis tool is available through the Streamlit web application.


Documentation
This documentation describes the grain detection methodology, adjustable parameters, statistical analysis, and usage of the web application.
